query:
SELECT COUNT(*) as total, 
       COUNT(CASE WHEN year = 2025 THEN 1 END) as y2025,
       COUNT(CASE WHEN year = 2024 THEN 1 END) as y2024,
       COUNT(CASE WHEN year = 2023 THEN 1 END) as y2023
FROM bibliography_entries;
